stages.title: Context and governance
stages.summary: The task exists, its scope is claimed, and the rules that apply are loaded.

stages.title: Implementation
stages.summary: The promised work is present in the tree.

stages.title: Tests and validation
stages.summary: The cases the change obliges ran and passed, and the change carries a test of its own.

stages.title: Documentation and generated artifacts
stages.summary: The documents a reader needs are written and every derived artifact is current.

stages.title: Commit and push
stages.summary: The work is in the branch's history and the branch has reached the remote.

stages.title: Gates
stages.summary: Every gate the change selects has reported over this tree, and none refuses.

stages.title: Version impact
stages.summary: The public contract was measured against the last release and the declared version is at least what it requires.

stages.title: Deployment
stages.summary: Every surface the change affects is serving the revision the task produced.

stages.title: Live verification
stages.summary: The deployed result was looked at after it was deployed, and it is the expected revision.

stages.title: Provenance
stages.summary: The session, the issue and the continuation record say what happened.

questions.question: Is all the work this task promised present in the tree?
Were the cases the change obliges run, and did they pass?
Does the change touch a test of its own?
questions.remediation: add a case under test/cases/ or a test beside the code

questions.question: Were the documents a reader needs updated?
Is every derived artifact current with its canonical source?
Are the OpenAPI document and the transport registries current?
Does every surface (command line, HTTP, MCP, Cockpit) agree with the registry?
Are the changes in the branch's history rather than in the working tree?
Has the commit reached the remote?
Has every gate the change selects reported, and did it pass?
Has the declared version moved as far as the public surface has?
Is the release's own record current with the tree?
Does the trunk reach this commit?
questions.remediation: open a pull request and land it

questions.question: Does the published site serve this commit?
Is the environment this change targets running it?
Was the deployed result looked at after it was deployed?
Is a branch, worktree or pull request left behind?
Is the session's continuation record written?
Do the issue and milestone this work belongs to say so?
